research_scope.warning: External views measure public demand and distribution, not private retention. Own-channel analytics measure viewing after the click. Comments are self-selected qualitative evidence and the counts below are conservative lower bounds, not audience prevalence estimates. Keep those evidence classes separate.

operator_direction.evidence_status: Operator interpretation supported by the current own-channel winner mix; validate with future native-script uploads.
operator_direction.primary_lane: Modern relationship revenge drama with one numerical system that drives a concrete money, ownership, career, status, influence, or skill climb.
operator_direction.secondary_lane: Isekai or reincarnation stories where the system and transported condition are essential to the click movie.
operator_direction.not_default: Generic guild, rank, gate, and dungeon fantasy.
operator_direction.romance_rule: Betrayal and replacement love must materially alter Joey's choices, leverage, progression, and revenge rather than decorate a combat ladder.
operator_direction.adaptation_rule: Do not reskin a completed fantasy script into a modern setting; preserve it and author a new causal premise.

interpretation: Fast winning recaps are causally dense rather than a chain of tiny dramatic fragments.
Meaningful turns and connected action-response-result sentences matter more than raw TTS speed.
Pacing stays broadly stable through all four runtime quarters in the primary corpus.

market_opening_modes.use_when: The package promises impossible competence, hidden rank, a transformed body, ownership, or public proof.
The package promises betrayal, rejection, exploitation, false weakness, abandonment, or humiliation.
The strange condition or singular rule is itself the click reason.

own_channel_opening_delivery_evidence.opening_pattern: First-person later outcome, one concrete numerical reversal, one satisfying refusal, then a clean third-person rewind.
own_channel_opening_delivery_evidence.lesson: The cold open is easy to repeat from memory because it uses one person at a window, one number, and one choice before backstory. The pattern is useful when the later consequence is easier to understand than the setup.

own_channel_opening_delivery_evidence.opening_pattern: Third-person linear title event, immediate public betrayal, then the replacement relationship enters before the scene loses momentum.
own_channel_opening_delivery_evidence.lesson: A linear opening can outperform a flash-forward when the title event is already concrete, socially legible, and visually dramatic. Outcome-choice-rewind is an option, not a universal gimmick.

market_package_findings.reusable_grammar: low or unusual status + one singular unfair advantage + one visible proof or outcome
market_package_findings.thumbnail_rule: Let the title explain the premise and let one simple thumbnail prove or extend one part of it.

own_channel_evidence.title: Reincarnated as the World's Biggest Simp, He Unlocks the Anti-Simp System | Manhwa Recap
own_channel_evidence.lesson: Extremely legible humiliation identity plus one corrective mechanic can win broad demand even when longform satisfaction is not the channel maximum.

own_channel_evidence.title: My Wife Poisoned Me, Then I Married the Goddess of Death | Manhwa Recap
own_channel_evidence.lesson: An intimate betrayal plus a visually obvious replacement relationship can combine click clarity with strong viewing.

own_channel_evidence.title: My Boss Stole My Fiancee And Fired Me, Then My $1 System Bought His Company | Manhwa Recap
own_channel_evidence.lesson: A complete causal title with a numerical mechanic and literal takeback produced the strongest watch minutes per viewer among the established winners.

own_channel_evidence.title: He Stole My GF and Humiliated Me, Then I Unlocked The 100X Learning System | Manhwa Recap
own_channel_evidence.lesson: A personal rival and one-line multiplier remain easy to understand and scale.

own_channel_evidence.title: I Spent $184,730 on Her, Then My 10X System Exposed Her | Manhwa Recap
own_channel_evidence.lesson: A precise receipt makes exploitation tangible; the simple exposure engine keeps the promise legible.

own_channel_negative_evidence.lesson: Lore, ranks, gates, and checklist completeness cannot replace an emotionally legible contradiction, an early choice, and causal movement.
A fantasy spouse noun and sexualized visual promise are not demand by themselves. The supernatural relationship must materially generate the progression, choices, and payoff.

own_channel_comment_findings.method: All available comments and replies were pulled across 61 uploads, then reviewed with a cited ChatGPT Web Pro dossier. Counts are conservative examples that met the coded pattern, not estimates of how common an opinion is among all viewers.

audience_trust.finding: Viewers accept an initially wounded, loyal, or naive Joey, but strongly reject him learning the betrayal and then casually remaining passive, submissive, or repeatedly self-defeating.
audience_trust.source_rule: Define decisive evidence, the required behavior update, an irreversible boundary, and a strategic-contact rule before prose. Do not erase Joey's human wound; make knowledge change conduct.

causal_and_continuity.finding: Viewers notice domain-irrelevant conflicts, unexplained capabilities, inconsistent knowledge, broken prop or ownership state, and other causal discontinuities.
causal_and_continuity.source_rule: Track critical state changes and require every major movement to alter the established stakes, relationships, knowledge, resources, choices, or route to payoff. Spectacle alone does not earn a movement.

repetition_and_payoff_delay.finding: The complaint is repeated story function, filler, and delayed promised events rather than long runtime by itself.
repetition_and_payoff_delay.source_rule: Track questions through real answers, pay literal title promises at named movements, and judge long scenes by state change rather than duration alone.

agency.finding: Systems remain part of the click appeal, but satisfaction depends on Joey applying leverage through judgment, receipts, tactics, and boundaries rather than obeying a system-authored life.
agency.source_rule: The system supplies leverage, information, options, or constraints. Joey owns goals, morality, tactics, and decisive action.

supporting_character_balance.finding: Capable allies add drama and credibility, but can weaken the fantasy if they solve the central problem or eclipse Joey's decisions.
supporting_character_balance.source_rule: Give allies wants and useful skills while preserving Joey's decisive story ownership.

closure.finding: A small number of comments identify severe missing payoff or closure; these are low-frequency but high-cost satisfaction failures.
closure.source_rule: Bind every title promise, central viewer question, antagonist loss, final boundary, and emotional afterimage before drafting.

production_context.interpretation: These remain production QA evidence. Narrator-only audio and current TTS/visual contracts already address much of this class, so source development should not add redundant creative passes for it.

decision_policy.core_channel_lane: Betrayal, rejection, or humiliation followed by one plain reversal engine remains the strongest own-channel prior.
challenger_lanes: visible proof or status contradiction without romantic betrayal
direct singular mechanic with immediate proof
found-family, academy, craft, rescue, or profession-native progression
decision_policy.portfolio_rule: Do not call betrayal a universal niche law. Keep it as the core channel prior and test adjacent package modes deliberately, one controlled challenger at a time.
decision_policy.selection_rule: Judge package demand and expected viewing separately. A high-click hypothesis is not automatically a strong longform script, and a high-AVD video that earned few impressions is not automatically a strong package.
decision_policy.failure_analogue_rule: Every finalist must name one positive transfer hypothesis and one plausible failure analogue before approval.
decision_policy.learning_rule: Do not rewrite the channel formula from one upload. Compare cohorts at 24 hours, 72 hours, 7 days, and 28 days, then update a versioned evidence snapshot.
